debug_name: Selva surface + chapel + descent + Limbo (all layers as one continuous world)
_comment: Per Inferno-vertical-stack doctrine: one scene per vertical-slice region. The chapel + descent corridor + Limbo platform are all in this scene as continuous geometry. The player walks from selva surface, into the chapel, down the descent, into Limbo — no scene transitions, no fades, no loading.
_static_meshes_note: Split out of the legacy crypt.glb in Commit 3 of the region-rebuild: chapel_exterior owns facade/walls/plinth/roof, chapel_interior owns interior floor + the entire descent staircase. Both share the same world_origin because they're authored in the same Blender file (one generator, sliced at export time by collection). When the 3-region split lands in Commit 5, chapel_interior moves to its own region.json (chapel_interior/region.json); for now both live in surface.
_terrain_modifiers_note: Authored chapel + Acheron terrain modifiers. Each modifier targets a terrain_region (selva_inner = colle + surrounding selva, limbo = Acheron disc) and is registered into the global TerrainModifier registry at boot by loadAllRegionsRegister() BEFORE initTerrain(). When the 3-region split lands in Commit 5, the limbo_acheron_trench entry moves into limbo/region.json.

terrain_modifiers._comment: Chapel exterior plateau. Terrain depresses to plinth-bottom Y (kChapelGroundY 22.3 - kPlinthHeight 0.30 = 22.0) around the chapel footprint, extended forward by the door-threshold ramp length (0.50m) so terrain covers under the ramp. Soft 2m blend on -X/+X/-Z, SHARP +Z edge at the threshold OUTER face (-205.5). See [[feedback_structures_own_terrain_seam]].

Corridor wedge FlushSlope. Terrain follows the descent corridor's ceiling roof down for ~7.74m past the chapel back wall (Z=-214 to Z=-221.74) so the gap between chapel back and natural terrain is filled by terrain sloping along the corridor roof. value at -Z edge (far_z=-221.74), value_far at +Z edge (near_z=-214, chapel back wall). Slope = kStairRise/kStairTread = 0.4571 per m.

Acheron trench. The river that cuts E-W across Limbo per [[project_acheron_river_lore]]. Disc Limbo radius 300m, center Z=-621.15. Trench is a chord at Z=-385 (~32m south of the corridor landing at Z=-353.15) -- the first feature the player encounters walking into Limbo. Trench depth 4m below Limbo floor (-43.13), 12m wide N-S, 340m wide E-W (170m half-extent stays 15m short of disc rim at ±185m). Sharp -X/+X edges (disc rim clips laterally), sloped -Z/+Z banks (5m blend pad = ~38° grade). Moves to limbo/region.json when Commit 5 splits regions.

_enemy_spawns_note: Empty until the region split (limbo region) lands. Limbo shades will be authored in limbo/region.json's enemy_spawns array. Schema documented in SCHEMA.md.
